label: No Reflection / No Retry Loop
description: Ablation isolating the value of reflection after review or validation failure. The LinguaSeeker agent workflow is single-pass by design and has no reflection/retry loop in production, so this condition is a no-op compared to C2 at the workflow level. The RetryablePhaseExecutor max_retries is set to 0 to disable infrastructure-level retries. Primary extraction, review validation, normalization, and source grounding are kept.
